source.rationale: Use the provider's northern validation block and shared buffered test IDs, remove every positive-area cross-role footprint overlap, and retain only one copy from each exact duplicate group within development roles.
source.test_policy: All 154 provider test IDs are locked outside development and subset selection.

spatial_audit.method: Pairwise intersections of complete georeferenced 512x512 image footprints; positive area above 0.01 m² counts as overlap.
spatial_audit.repeated_building_limit: Disjoint footprints prevent the same visible building from appearing across roles, but do not establish independence of nearby architecture, capture conditions or map-source processing.

training_subsets.method: Seeded maximin sampling of image-footprint centres within the retained training pool; subsets are nested within each repetition.
